usageNotes: Use this to list all API tokens associated with a given Proxmox user (e.g., before auditing expiry dates or before creating/deleting a token). Any user can list their own tokens; listing another user's tokens requires the User.Modify privilege. Note that this endpoint returns token metadata only — the actual secret value is never retrievable after initial creation.

examples.summary: List all API tokens for the local admin user

tips: Token secrets are shown only once at creation time (via the create endpoint); this list endpoint cannot retrieve them.
privsep: true (the default) means the token's effective permissions are the intersection of the token's ACLs and the user's ACLs — it cannot exceed the user's own rights.
An expire value of 0 means the token never expires; check this during access audits to flag unbounded tokens.
To inspect a single token's details, use the child resource: GET /access/users/{userid}/token/{tokenid}.
